title: Astro Portal API v1 consent to the project's sky-brightness calibration set
description: GET, PUT and DELETE /v1/space/calibration (docs/CONTRIBUTION_RULES.md; packages/portal/src/persistence/calibration-contribution-repository.js, tables calibration_contributions and calibration_ledger; packages/portal-app/src/routes/api/v1/space/calibration/route.js). With the observer's explicit consent — off by default, asked only in the section of their space — the service keeps an anonymised record of each sky-background value the space holds (each night measured by Astro Sync at a place, POST /v1/place-sky-measures, and each place's entered value, `skyEntered`): the seven fields of `record`, never a place, a coordinate, a name, a path or an identifier. GET reads the consent of the credential's space; PUT `{ enabled }` switches it (on: the values the space already holds are kept at once; off: nothing new is kept, what is kept stays); DELETE withdraws: the space's records and its ledger are deleted and the consent is switched off. A release of the set already made cannot be recalled. Either credential (a device bearer, or a web session with its CSRF token for PUT and DELETE). A private server answers 404 `not_available` and never contributes. Errors: 400 invalid_request, 404 not_available, 503 calibration_storage_unavailable.

consent.description: The consent of the space: whether it is on, since when (`null` when off), how many records the space has in the set (`kept`) and when the last one was kept or replaced (`lastKeptAt`, `null` without any).

update.description: The body of PUT: the switch, and nothing else.

withdrawn.description: 200 of DELETE: how many records were deleted, and the consent after (off, nothing kept).

record.description: One contribution: the whole of what is kept (docs/CONTRIBUTION_RULES.md). `band` is `camera` for a measured value and `sqm` for an entered one; `radianceLevel` is the sky-quality raster's own 256-level log encoding of the place's cell; `region` the calibration region (`global` outside every region); `year` only; `methodVersion` for a measured value, `null` for an entered one.

release.description: One release of the set: a version, the instant it was made, and the records in a random order — no row key, no ledger.
